A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same semantic-navigation study. The complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.7 support reliable comparison despite changes in placement and pagination.

before.justification: Section 3 and Appendices A.3–A.7 report original analyses of four human concept-production datasets, including group differences, cross-model correlations, and cumulative versus non-cumulative embedding comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical analyses and their outcomes, including the main results, Table 2, whitening analysis, and additional embedding-model results in the appendices.

M1.justification: The cumulative embedding procedure, five trajectory metrics, encoder choices, and whitening procedure are unchanged. No algorithmic component or model modification is introduced.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Neurodegenerative, Swear Fluency, Italian, and German datasets, with the same languages, populations, categories, and property-listing or verbal-fluency tasks.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, Google text-embedding-004, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, and fastText. Table 2 retains the same cumulative and non-cumulative variants, and Appendices A.5–A.7 retain the same comparator results.

E3.justification: Sample sizes, preprocessing, trajectory construction, unit time steps, metrics, and comparison procedures remain unchanged in Section 2 and the appendices. No new evaluation protocol or experimental setting is reported.

E4.justification: The cross-encoder correlation analysis, cumulative versus non-cumulative comparison in Appendix A.3, and ZCA-whitening robustness analysis in Appendix A.4 are retained unchanged. Their relocation does not add an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions specify the same GLMM distributions, Tukey-adjusted comparisons, 95% confidence intervals, and Cohen's d summaries. Neither adds seed information, repeated-run reporting, or a new uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: The numerical table entries, plotted results, and reported findings are unchanged, including all appendix figures. For example, Table 2 retains 10 significant pairs, weighted count 27, and mean Cohen's d of 0.30 for the cumulative OpenAI Neurodegenerative result.

T1.justification: The trajectory definitions, median-binarized entropy, velocity and acceleration equations (1)–(4), and Euclidean and unit-time assumptions are unchanged. No mathematical correction, derivation, theorem, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about clinical and category discrimination, trajectory-length-dependent benefits of cumulative embeddings, and consistency across embedding models.

C2.justification: The interpretations of clinical disorganization, swear-word retrieval, language differences, and model-dependent global geometry are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning missing timestamps, Euclidean geometry, and the basic entropy measure.

D1.justification: Implementation details, software information, and dataset access instructions are unchanged. The reproducibility statement replaces its repository placeholder with the same URL already linked in v1's abstract; this adds no new resource or technical disclosure.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same. Bibliographic URLs and some journal, volume, page, and identifier metadata are revised, but these changes do not introduce different works or alter relationships to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 adds a FAPESP funding acknowledgment, completes the reproducibility statement's repository link, and revises reference metadata and URL formatting. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 moves below its explanatory paragraph, Table 2 shifts to the following page, and Figure 7 occupies a separate page after its discussion. The figure content, axes, captions, and table structure are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves documentation and usability by removing the reproducibility placeholder, adding direct links to many existing references, and disclosing funding support. The repository was already accessible from v1's abstract, and the scientific methods, evidence, and conclusions are unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to editorial clarity and transparency.
